Name: BOTW Horse Whistle
Author: olioleander
Description:
I just thought it would be fun for the horse flute to sound like the horse whistle sound from Breath of the Wild :)

To install, make sure you have SMAPI and Content Patcher, and then unzip the .zip into your Mods folder.

Downloads.Description: Updated for 1.6 - no longer needs Custom Music

Manifest.Name: BOTW Horse Whistle
Manifest.Description: Changes the horse flute sound to the whistle from Breath of the Wild.
